paragraphs.text: Breaking the Magic (also BtM ) is a Magic: The Gathering -oriented webcomic by Tiago Nunes, who is registered on the MTGSalvation forums as ghosthack .
Breaking the Magic's first comic was published on 6 March 2007.

This comic started with standalone humor comics about Magic: the Gathering, but soon evolved to a story-driven comic. This was to stand out from previous existing Magic webcomics, such as UG Madness and Manascrewed , taking a more flavor-like perspective than a gaming one.
